scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Rajya Nirashrit Mahila Samman Pension Yojana
other_conditions: Single woman aged 45 years or more
Must not be a beneficiary under any other Social Security pension scheme
Must not be retired or permanently employed in Central or State Government or public sector undertakings
Applicant or spouse must not receive any family pension or pension from Central or State Government or public sector undertakings
Applicant’s family is not an income tax payee
benefits_summary: ₹1,000 per month pension transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account.
